purpose.zh: 坐在椅子上拉伸大腿后侧
purpose.en: Stretch the back of your thigh from your chair.

text.zh: 一条腿伸直放前面，背挺直，上身往前倾
text.en: Straighten one leg forward and lean forward with a long back

text.zh: 坐在椅子前半部分，伸直那条腿脚跟着地、脚尖勾起。
text.en: Sit near the front of the chair, straight leg heel down, toes up.

text.zh: 保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
text.en: Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.

text.zh: 别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。
text.en: Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

commonErrors.en: Rounding the back to reach the foot.

cautions.zh: 大腿后侧疼或发麻时幅度小一点，还不舒服就停
cautions.en: If the back of your thigh hurts or tingles, ease off, and stop if it continues.
